name: List a digital product on Gumroad (Discover-ready)
goal: Open a Gumroad seller account, account for ~10% platform + payment-processing fees, create a digital product with name/description/files/price, and publish so it can sell and potentially appear on Gumroad Discover.

source.title: How To Sell Digital Products on Gumroad

constraints: Operational freelancing/product procedure only — no get-rich-quick claims.
Ground every step in YouTube-provided captions; adapt UI labels if the product renamed menus.
Price in ~10% Gumroad + ~2–3%+ processing when setting list price.

steps.action: Create free Gumroad account; read fee schedule (~10% plus PayPal/Stripe processing → often ~12–13%+ all-in).
Products → New product → name → select Digital product.
Write full description/sales copy; upload thumbnail and downloadable files.
Set price (and versions/upsells if needed); save.
Publish/list so checkout works and Discover can surface it.
